classificationDefinitions.surfaced: An explicit mobile screen, control, or user action exposes this operation.
classificationDefinitions.internal: The provider or a bounded realtime/system flow consumes this operation without a separate user control.
classificationDefinitions.alternate: Mobile provides the same outcome through a named safer or more complete operation, so this operation is not forwarded.
classificationDefinitions.intentionally-omitted: The operation is outside the approved mobile product or safety boundary and is not forwarded.
